title: A/R Detail: the Customer menu ticks several customers and the chip counts them
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customers {Customer-A} and {Customer-B} have open invoices on today's date; {Customer-B}'s name is longer than the chip can show.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-28 Short and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-28 Northern Alberta Heavy Equipment and Trailer Repair.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Finance > A/R Detail is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Customer chip and read the menu from top to bottom.
  2. Type part of {Customer-B}'s name in the search box and tick {Customer-B}.
  3. Read the chip.
  4. Search for {Customer-A} and tick it.
  5. Read the chip and expand every group.
  6. Untick both customers.
  7. Read the chip.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens with a search box, an "All customers" row, the line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." and the list of customers.
  • Step 2: {Customer-B} is ticked.
  • Step 3: the chip shows {Customer-B}'s name, shortened with "..." because it is long.
  • Step 4: {Customer-A} is ticked as well.
  • Step 5: the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers"; only the two customers' rows remain.
  • Step 6: no customer is ticked.
  • Step 7: "Customer: All customers" in the resting (grey) style.

The Customer chip is the native one (as on Sales By Customer): with one name ticked, and for a long name, it reads as that chip does.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
